notes.title: The Benza RPG Version 3.0 is here in our last major update to the main story!
notes.content:
About a week ago, Gui and I found ourselves programming the end movie to The Benza RPG.  It felt very surreal.  We took a look at the clock on the editing software, and we realized that by the time we finish with the game we will have spent 1000 hours working it.  That doesn’t include the countless playtesting sessions and upload sessions to Apple, Android, and Steam.

1000 hours.  At times it feels like it was a lot shorter than that.  Gui and I laugh a lot while we work.  I talk to him about plot points for episodes I’m still writing for The Benza.  He tells me about what it’s like being a full-time programmer.  We’re quite the odd couple when you think about it!

At times it feels a lot longer than that.  There have been times we really wanted RPG MAKER MV to do something that it just can’t do.  There have been times we had to sacrifice things because of memory limitations.  Being an odd couple leads to misunderstandings and communication break downs that must be overcome.

Having said that, The Benza overall is a rag tag team made up of the ODDEST couples you’ve ever seen.  I think that is what makes our team work.  Looking back at this game, it’s the mix of what each individual member of the team brings to the table that has sailed us through the rough waters and got us laughing into the harbor.

When we started this, it really was just Gui and I working on what we thought would take us a couple of months to finish.  As we round the two year point and our team stands at about twenty people, it feels really good to have made it this far without giving up.

Looking forward, Gui and I foresee making one more large update in the coming months with finished art work and additional assets.  It took about a year and a half, but we both feel very comfortable with where our party members and abilities are at.  Unless we get some large feedback from players about something feeling unbalanced, we will be moving forward to Nintendo Switch development.

As we near the end of The Benza RPG’s development, I just want to take a moment to say thank you to all of the people who have messaged me directly over The Benza’s official account on Twitter or via email.  We were able to nip some bugs in the butt and handle some balancing issues thanks to your time and support.  My favorite message up to now has just been one sentence long.  I will sign this blog off with that sentence below.

“Help, how do I kill Bob?”
Heh.

-Chris

notes.title: The Benza RPG Version 3.0 is here in our last major update to the main story!
notes.content:
-The Benza RPG is playable from start to finish!  The Japanese school is now playable from floors 1 to 50!
-A new area has been added to the Shadow Circus that is only playable by Hamilton’s “Call” magic.  This area is accessible after Hamilton joins the party.
-Extensive additions have been made to the voice acting cast including Bob Werley (Bob), Shizuka Anderson (Carol), Hiro Ono (Hiro), and many more characters from Benza English!  
-Over 200 lines of new spoken dialog have been added to the game!
-All character’s stats have been balanced to reflect their roles at the end of the game.
-“Callable” characters now gain levels easier and have increased stats to make them more viable throughout the entire game.
-5th tier weapons and armor have been added.
-New monster art has been added to various points of the game.
-Additional moves have been added to many of the “callable” characters and to main party members including Chris and Tamura.
